Solaris Asset Management Trimmed Its Position in Apple (AAPL) by $327,860 as Share Value Declined; Arista Networks (ANET) Holder Atika Capital Management Has Raised Its Stake
May 27, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Brad Farber increased its stake in Arista Networks Inc (ANET) by 65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atika Capital Management Llc bought 13,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.25% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Brad Farber held 33,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.77 million, up from 20,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atika Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Arista Networks Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.03B market cap company. The stock increased 1.24% or $3.14 $255.75. About 531,512 shares traded. Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE:ANET) has risen 91.94% outperformed by 80.39% the S&P500.
Solaris Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Solaris Asset Management Llc sold 1,940 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 41,289 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.99M, down from 43,229 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Solaris Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
